# Not in this release (next updates)
1. Face unlock for the lock screen (needs a face model downloaded from the internet; moved out so this release stays stable).
2. Keeping web apps alive even when Android closes BrowOS from the recent-apps list (needs an Android background service). Pressing Back or Home already leaves web apps running; Shut down closes them.
3. Sign in with Google (needs a Google Cloud project).
4. Full translation of every screen (the main screens are translated into Arabic, French and Spanish).
5. Widgets pinned on the desktop (the widgets board exists).
6. Chromium window extras: popups, file downloads and uploads, fullscreen video.
7. Backing up photos, music and other files (the backup file has settings, notes, pins, Vault and lock password).
8. Reading your phone's own folders; offline PDF engine; more keyboard shortcuts.
9. Calendar, Contacts, Nearby devices and Phone permissions (BrowOS has no feature that needs them yet).
10. Researched and NOT possible in this kind of app: running other Android apps (APK files) inside BrowOS without installing them, and running Windows .exe files such as Roblox. Android cannot run Windows programs, and an app cannot create a second Android system inside itself. A retro-games player with on-screen controls (for game files you own) could be built instead.
